name: Zetsu
background: Zetsu was a unique, plant-like being composed of two distinct personalities: White Zetsu and Black Zetsu. White Zetsu served as an observer and information gatherer for Akatsuki, while Black Zetsu was a manifestation of Kaguya Ōtsutsuki’s will, seeking her resurrection. Together, they played critical roles in the Akatsuki's plans, including manipulating events leading to the Fourth Shinobi World War.

abilities.name: Mayfly
abilities.description: Allows Zetsu to merge with and travel through the ground and trees at high speed, making him undetectable.

abilities.name: Spore Technique
abilities.description: Creates spores that attach to enemies, draining their chakra while growing into clones of Zetsu.

abilities.name: Subterranean Voyage
abilities.description: Enables Zetsu to travel underground stealthily, avoiding detection and escaping threats.

abilities.name: White Zetsu Army Clone Technique
abilities.description: Generates a massive number of clones from White Zetsu’s body, used for large-scale battles.

abilities.name: Transformation Technique
abilities.description: White Zetsu’s ability to perfectly mimic the appearance and chakra of others, making infiltration seamless.

abilities.name: Black Zetsu Manipulation
abilities.description: Black Zetsu’s ability to attach to and control others’ bodies, influencing their actions.

relationships.name: Obito Uchiha
relationships.dynamic: Served as Obito's loyal subordinate, assisting in the execution of the Eye of the Moon Plan.

relationships.name: Kaguya Ōtsutsuki
relationships.dynamic: Black Zetsu was created by Kaguya's will and worked tirelessly to orchestrate her resurrection.

relationships.name: Akatsuki
relationships.dynamic: Zetsu served as the organization’s spy and cleanup crew, gathering intel and disposing of bodies.

relationships.name: White Zetsu Army
relationships.dynamic: White Zetsu created clones of himself to act as soldiers during the Fourth Shinobi World War.

quotes.text: Well to say it simply… He wants to get rid of all the bad things in the world and run away to a dreamland full of good things! In a dream you can do whatever you want… even revive the dead.
quotes.context: Explaining the Eye of the Moon Plan to Obito.

quotes.text: It'll be all right, after all, Tobi is a good boy.
quotes.context: White Zetsu to Black Zetsu, endorsing Tobi’s role in Akatsuki.

quotes.text: When you're sad and alone… The only one you can count on is yourself.
quotes.context: White Zetsu and Black Zetsu discussing self-reliance with Hidan.

quotes.text: The next time you open your eyes you'll be seeing a whole new world… things are getting really fun!
My Transformation Technique is the best out of all shinobi… the tale of shinobi... a story for the sake of my Mother’s resurrection.
quotes.context: White Zetsu boasting about his transformation abilities, followed by Black Zetsu revealing his true purpose.
